$comment: What tv-apply.mjs checks before it installs anything on the TV. The Claude files are git-ignored (apk/); their hashes and signer are recorded here. Provenance, proven 3 Nov 2026: the three files are byte-identical (SHA-256) to the copy the Play Store installed on the POCO X6 (pm path com.anthropic.claude; installerPackageName=com.android.vending, initiatingPackageName=com.android.vending), pulled read-only over adb and compared, and apksigner verify --print-certs (build-tools 36.0.0) gives the same signer and source-stamp certificates for both sets. Any other Claude build (an older one for an SDK < 32 TV) must carry the same signer SHA-256: tv-apply.mjs --install-claude --apk-dir <dir> refuses it otherwise.

claude.signerDN: CN=Android, OU=Android, O=Google Inc., L=Mountain View, ST=California, C=US (Play App Signing key held by Google for Anthropic)
claude.schemes: v3 only (no v1/v2); Verified for SourceStamp: true
